translations.literal: Wei was made Observation Commissioner of Huazhou, Deputy Overall Commander of the Fuyan circuit, and Frontier Inspector and Pacification Commissioner for Huan, Qing, Qin, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Wei was made Observation Commissioner of Huazhou, Deputy Overall Commander of the Fuyan circuit, and Frontier Inspector and Pacification Commissioner for Huan, Qing, Qin, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 委乞、骨咩、大門等族聞瑋至，歸附者甚眾。

translations.literal: When the Weiq, Gume, Daman, and other tribes heard Wei had arrived, very many submitted.
translations.idiomatic: When the Weiq, Gume, Daman, and other tribes heard Wei had arrived, very many submitted.

sentences.zh: 拜宣徽北院使、鎮國軍節度觀察留後、簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: He was appointed Commissioner of the Northern Court of the Palace Secretariat, Military Governor and Observation Regent of the Zhenguo Army, and Co-signer of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Commissioner of the Northern Court of the Palace Secretariat, Military Governor and Observation Regent of the Zhenguo Army, and Co-signer of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 宰相丁謂逐寇準，惡瑋不附己，指為準黨。

translations.literal: The chief minister Ding Wei drove out Kou Zhun, hated Wei for not siding with him, and denounced him as a member of Zhun's faction.
translations.idiomatic: The chief minister Ding Wei drove out Kou Zhun, hated Wei for not siding with him, and denounced him as a member of Zhun's faction.

sentences.zh: 除南院使、環慶路都總管安撫使。

translations.literal: He was removed to Commissioner of the Southern Court and Overall Commander and Pacification Commissioner of the Huanqing circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was removed to Commissioner of the Southern Court and Overall Commander and Pacification Commissioner of the Huanqing circuit.

sentences.zh: 乾興初，謫左衛大將軍、容州觀察使、知萊州。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qianxing he was demoted to General of the Left Guard, Observation Commissioner of Rongzhou, and governor of Laizhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Qianxing he was demoted to General of the Left Guard, Observation Commissioner of Rongzhou, and governor of Laizhou.

sentences.zh: 瑋以宿將為謂所忌，即日上道，從弱卒十餘人，不以弓韔矢箙自隨。

translations.literal: Wei, a veteran general envied by Ding Wei, set out that same day with only a dozen or so weak soldiers and did not carry bow cases or quivers himself.
translations.idiomatic: Wei, a veteran general envied by Ding Wei, set out that same day with only a dozen or so weak soldiers and did not carry bow cases or quivers himself.

sentences.zh: 謂敗，復華州觀察使、知青州，徙天雄軍，以彰化軍節度觀察留後知永興軍。

translations.literal: When Ding Wei fell he was restored as Observation Commissioner of Huazhou and governor of Qingzhou, transferred to the Tianxiong Army, and made Military Governor and Observation Regent of the Zhanghua Army and commander of the Yongxing Army.
translations.idiomatic: When Ding Wei fell he was restored as Observation Commissioner of Huazhou and governor of Qingzhou, transferred to the Tianxiong Army, and made Military Governor and Observation Regent of the Zhanghua Army and commander of the Yongxing Army.

sentences.zh: 拜昭武軍節度使、知天雄軍。

translations.literal: He was appointed military governor of the Zhaowu Army and commander of the Tianxiong Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed military governor of the Zhaowu Army and commander of the Tianxiong Army.

sentences.zh: 以疾守河陽，數月，為真定府、定州都總管，改彰武軍節度使。

translations.literal: Because of illness he held Heyang; after several months he became Overall Commander of Zhending Prefecture and Dingzhou and was changed to military governor of the Zhangwu Army.
translations.idiomatic: Because of illness he held Heyang; after several months he became Overall Commander of Zhending Prefecture and Dingzhou and was changed to military governor of the Zhangwu Army.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈侍中，諡武穆。

translations.literal: He died and was posthumously made Palace Attendant with the posthumous title Wumu.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously made Palace Attendant with the posthumous title Wumu.

sentences.zh: 瑋用士，得其死力。

translations.literal: Wei employed men and obtained their utmost loyalty unto death.
translations.idiomatic: Wei employed men and obtained their utmost loyalty unto death.

sentences.zh: 平居甚閒暇，及師出，多奇計，出入神速不可測。

translations.literal: In ordinary times he was very leisurely, but when the army went out he used many stratagems and moved in and out with such speed as to be unpredictable.
translations.idiomatic: In ordinary times he was very leisurely, but when the army went out he used many stratagems and moved in and out with such speed as to be unpredictable.

sentences.zh: 一日，張樂飲僚吏，中坐失瑋所在，明日，徐出觀事，而賊首已擲庭下矣。

translations.literal: One day, while feasting with his staff to music, Wei vanished from his seat midway; the next day he calmly came out to attend to business, and the enemy chieftain's head had already been thrown in the courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: One day, while feasting with his staff to music, Wei vanished from his seat midway; the next day he calmly came out to attend to business, and the enemy chieftain's head had already been thrown in the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 嘗稱疾，加砭艾，臥閣內不出。

translations.literal: He once claimed illness, applied moxibustion, and lay inside the pavilion without coming out.
translations.idiomatic: He once claimed illness, applied moxibustion, and lay inside the pavilion without coming out.

sentences.zh: 會賊至，瑋奮起裹創，被甲跨馬，賊望見，皆遁去。

translations.literal: When bandits arrived Wei roused himself, bound his wounds, donned armor, mounted a horse, and at the sight of him they all fled.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits arrived Wei roused himself, bound his wounds, donned armor, mounted a horse, and at the sight of him they all fled.

sentences.zh: 將兵幾四十年，未嘗少失利。

translations.literal: He commanded troops for nearly forty years and never suffered even a slight defeat.
translations.idiomatic: He commanded troops for nearly forty years and never suffered even a slight defeat.

sentences.zh: 唃廝嵒聞瑋名，即望瑋所在，東向合手加顙。

translations.literal: When Gusiluo heard Wei's name he would face where Wei was, turn east, and put his palms together to his forehead.
translations.idiomatic: When Gusiluo heard Wei's name he would face where Wei was, turn east, and put his palms together to his forehead.

sentences.zh: 契丹使過天雄，部勒其下曰：「曹公在此，毋縱騎馳驅也。

translations.literal: When a Khitan envoy passed through Tianxiong he ordered his subordinates: "Lord Cao is here — do not let your horses gallop freely."
translations.idiomatic: When a Khitan envoy passed through Tianxiong he ordered his subordinates, "Lord Cao is here — do not let your horses gallop freely."

sentences.zh: 」真宗慎兵事，凡邊事，必手詔詰難至十數反，而瑋守初議，卒無以奪。

translations.literal: Zhenzong was cautious about military affairs; for every frontier matter he would personally edict questions and challenges as many as ten times, yet Wei held to his original view and in the end could not be overborne.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenzong was cautious about military affairs; for every frontier matter he would personally edict questions and challenges as many as ten times, yet Wei held to his original view and in the end could not be overborne.

sentences.zh: 後雖他將論邊事者，往往密付瑋處之。

translations.literal: Later, even when other generals discussed frontier affairs, matters were often secretly entrusted to Wei to handle.
translations.idiomatic: Later, even when other generals discussed frontier affairs, matters were often secretly entrusted to Wei to handle.

sentences.zh: 渭州有告戍卒叛入夏國者，瑋方對客奕棋，遽曰：「吾使之行也。

translations.literal: At Weizhou someone reported that garrison soldiers had defected to the Xia state; Wei was playing go with a guest and suddenly said: "I sent them."
translations.idiomatic: At Weizhou someone reported that garrison soldiers had defected to the Xia state; Wei was playing go with a guest and suddenly said, "I sent them."

sentences.zh: 」夏人聞之，即斬叛者，投其首境上。

translations.literal: When the Xia people heard this they at once executed the defectors and threw their heads on the border.
translations.idiomatic: When the Xia people heard this they at once executed the defectors and threw their heads on the border.

sentences.zh: 羌殺邊民，入羊馬贖罪。

translations.literal: When Qiang killed frontier people they presented sheep and horses to redeem their guilt.
translations.idiomatic: When Qiang killed frontier people they presented sheep and horses to redeem their guilt.

sentences.zh: 瑋下令曰：「羌自相犯，從其俗；

translations.literal: Wei issued an order: "When Qiang violate one another, follow their custom;"
translations.idiomatic: Wei issued an order: "When Qiang violate one another, follow their custom;"

sentences.zh: 犯邊民者，論如律。

translations.literal: "those who violate frontier people are judged according to law."
translations.idiomatic: "those who violate frontier people are judged according to law."

sentences.zh: 」自是無敢犯。

translations.literal: From then on none dared to violate it.
translations.idiomatic: From then on none dared to violate it.

sentences.zh: 環、慶屬羌田多為邊人所市，致單弱不能自存，因沒彼中。

translations.literal: Qiang fields belonging to Huan and Qing were largely bought up by frontier people, leaving the weak unable to survive on their own and thus lost to the other side.
translations.idiomatic: Qiang fields belonging to Huan and Qing were largely bought up by frontier people, leaving the weak unable to survive on their own and thus lost to the other side.

sentences.zh: 瑋盡令還其故田，後有犯者，遷其家內地。

translations.literal: Wei ordered all their old fields returned; afterward violators had their families moved inland.
translations.idiomatic: Wei ordered all their old fields returned; afterward violators had their families moved inland.

sentences.zh: 所募弓箭手，使馳射，較強弱，勝者與田二頃。

translations.literal: Among the archers he recruited he had them shoot on horseback and compare strength; winners were given two qing of land.
translations.idiomatic: Among the archers he recruited he had them shoot on horseback and compare strength; winners were given two qing of land.

sentences.zh: 再更秋獲，課市一馬，馬必勝甲，然後官籍之，則加五十畝。

translations.literal: After two autumn harvests they were assessed to purchase one horse; the horse had to be superior armor-capable, and only then was it registered by the state, with fifty mu added.
translations.idiomatic: After two autumn harvests they were assessed to purchase one horse; the horse had to be superior armor-capable, and only then was it registered by the state, with fifty mu added.

sentences.zh: 至三百人以上，團為一指揮。

translations.literal: When they reached three hundred or more they were grouped as one command.
translations.idiomatic: When they reached three hundred or more they were grouped as one command.

sentences.zh: 要害處為築堡，使自塹其地為方田環之。

translations.literal: At key points forts were built and they were made to trench the land themselves into square fields encircling them.
translations.idiomatic: At key points forts were built and they were made to trench the land themselves into square fields encircling them.

sentences.zh: 立馬社，一馬死，眾出錢市馬。

translations.literal: Horse societies were established: when one horse died, all contributed money to buy a horse.
translations.idiomatic: Horse societies were established: when one horse died, all contributed money to buy a horse.

sentences.zh: 降者既多，因制屬羌百帳以上，其首領為本族軍主，次為指揮使，又其次為副指揮使，不及百帳為本族指揮使。

translations.literal: Since there were many who submitted, regulations were made: for dependent Qiang of a hundred tents or more, the chief was army master of the tribe, next rank commander, next deputy commander; fewer than a hundred tents made one tribal commander.
translations.idiomatic: Since there were many who submitted, regulations were made: for dependent Qiang of a hundred tents or more, the chief was army master of the tribe, next rank commander, next deputy commander; fewer than a hundred tents made one tribal commander.

sentences.zh: 其蕃落將校，止於本軍敘進，以其習知羌情與地利，不可徙他軍也。

translations.literal: Their barbarian officers were promoted only within their own army, because they knew Qiang conditions and local terrain and could not be transferred to other armies.
translations.idiomatic: Their barbarian officers were promoted only within their own army, because they knew Qiang conditions and local terrain and could not be transferred to other armies.

sentences.zh: 開邊壕，率令深廣丈五尺；

translations.literal: Frontier trenches were opened, generally ordered to be one zhang and five chi deep and wide;
translations.idiomatic: Frontier trenches were opened, generally ordered to be one zhang and five chi deep and wide;

sentences.zh: 山險不可塹者，因其峭絕治之，使足以限敵，後皆以為法。

translations.literal: where mountains were steep and could not be trenched, they were worked along their sheer cliffs so as to be sufficient to limit the enemy — later all took this as the standard.
translations.idiomatic: where mountains were steep and could not be trenched, they were worked along their sheer cliffs so as to be sufficient to limit the enemy — later all took this as the standard.

sentences.zh: 天雄卒有犯盜者，眾謂獄具必殺之，瑋乃處以常法。

translations.literal: At Tianxiong a soldier committed theft; everyone said that once the case was complete he would surely be executed, but Wei dealt with him by ordinary law.
translations.idiomatic: At Tianxiong a soldier committed theft; everyone said that once the case was complete he would surely be executed, but Wei dealt with him by ordinary law.

sentences.zh: 人或以為疑，瑋笑曰：「臨邊對敵，斬不用命者，所以令眾吾，非好殺也。

translations.literal: Some found this doubtful; Wei smiled and said: "Facing the enemy on the frontier, beheading those who disobey orders is to make the troops fear — it is not a love of killing."
translations.idiomatic: Some found this doubtful; Wei smiled and said, "Facing the enemy on the frontier, beheading those who disobey orders is to make the troops fear — it is not a love of killing."

sentences.zh: 治內郡，安事此乎？」

translations.literal: "Governing an inner commandery — what need is there for such things?"
translations.idiomatic: "Governing an inner commandery — what need is there for such things?"

sentences.zh: 初守邊時，山東知名士賈同造瑋，客外舍。

translations.literal: When he first guarded the frontier, the renowned scholar of Shandong Jia Tong visited Wei and lodged in the outer guest quarters.
translations.idiomatic: When he first guarded the frontier, the renowned scholar of Shandong Jia Tong visited Wei and lodged in the outer guest quarters.

sentences.zh: 瑋欲按邊，即同舍，邀與俱。

translations.literal: When Wei wished to inspect the frontier he went to Tong's quarters and invited him to go together.
translations.idiomatic: When Wei wished to inspect the frontier he went to Tong's quarters and invited him to go together.

sentences.zh: 同問：「從兵安在？

translations.literal: Tong asked: "Where are the accompanying troops?"
translations.idiomatic: Tong asked, "Where are the accompanying troops?"

sentences.zh: 」曰：「已具。

translations.literal: He said: "They are ready."
translations.idiomatic: He said, "They are ready."

sentences.zh: 」既出就騎，見甲士三千環列，初不聞人馬聲。

translations.literal: When they went out to mount they saw three thousand armored soldiers arrayed in a ring, yet at first heard neither men nor horses.
translations.idiomatic: When they went out to mount they saw three thousand armored soldiers arrayed in a ring, yet at first heard neither men nor horses.

sentences.zh: 同歸，語人曰：「瑋殆名將也。

translations.literal: Tong returned and told others: "Wei is probably a famous general."
translations.idiomatic: Tong returned and told others, "Wei is probably a famous general."

sentences.zh: 」瑋為將不如其父寬，然自為一家。

translations.literal: As a general Wei was not as broad as his father, yet he formed a school of his own.
translations.idiomatic: As a general Wei was not as broad as his father, yet he formed a school of his own.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐八年，詔配享仁宗廟庭。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Jiayou an edict ordered him to share sacrificial honors in the court of Renzong's temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Jiayou an edict ordered him to share sacrificial honors in the court of Renzong's temple.

sentences.zh: 子 琮

translations.literal: Son: Cong
translations.idiomatic: Son: Cong

sentences.zh: 琮，字寶章。

translations.literal: Cong, styled Baozhang.
translations.idiomatic: Cong, styled Baozhang.

sentences.zh: 兄珝，娶秦王女興平郡主。

translations.literal: His elder brother Xu married the Princess of Xingping, daughter of the Prince of Qin.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother Xu married the Princess of Xingping, daughter of the Prince of Qin.

sentences.zh: 琮幼時，從主入禁中，太宗置膝上，拊其背曰：「曹氏有功我家，此亦佳兒也。

translations.literal: When Cong was young he entered the palace with the princess; Taizong set him on his knee, patted his back, and said: "The Cao house has served merit to our house — this too is a fine boy."
translations.idiomatic: When Cong was young he entered the palace with the princess; Taizong set him on his knee, patted his back, and said, "The Cao house has served merit to our house — this too is a fine boy."

sentences.zh: 」及彬領鎮海軍節度使，補衙內都指揮使。

translations.literal: When Bin held the post of military governor of the Zhenhai Army he was appointed Inner Staff Overall Commander.
translations.idiomatic: When Bin held the post of military governor of the Zhenhai Army he was appointed Inner Staff Overall Commander.

sentences.zh: 彬卒，時遷西頭供奉官、閣門祗候、勾當騏驥院、群牧估馬司，市馬課有羨，再遷西上閣門副使。

translations.literal: When Bin died he was then Western Head Palace Attendant, Gate Usher, manager of the Imperial Stud and the Pasturage Horse Appraisal Office; his horse-purchase quotas showed surplus and he was again promoted to Deputy Upper West Gate Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When Bin died he was then Western Head Palace Attendant, Gate Usher, manager of the Imperial Stud and the Pasturage Horse Appraisal Office; his horse-purchase quotas showed surplus and he was again promoted to Deputy Upper West Gate Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 與曹利用連姻，利用貶，出為河陽兵馬都監，領內軍器庫，遷東上閣門使、榮州刺史。

translations.literal: He was connected by marriage to Cao Liyong; when Liyong was demoted he was sent out as overall military commissioner of Heyang, given charge of the Inner Armory, and transferred to Upper East Gate Commissioner and Prefect of Rongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was connected by marriage to Cao Liyong; when Liyong was demoted he was sent out as overall military commissioner of Heyang, given charge of the Inner Armory, and transferred to Upper East Gate Commissioner and Prefect of Rongzhou.

sentences.zh: 仁宗冊琮兄女為后，禮皆琮主辦，除衛州團練使。

translations.literal: When Renzong enfeoffed Cong's elder brother's daughter as empress, Cong managed all the rites and was made regimental commissioner of Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Renzong enfeoffed Cong's elder brother's daughter as empress, Cong managed all the rites and was made regimental commissioner of Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 琮因奏曰：「陛下方以至公屬天下，臣既備后族，不宜冒恩澤，亂朝廷法。

translations.literal: Cong thereupon memorialized: "Your Majesty is just now entrusting the realm to utmost fairness; your servant, being of the empress's clan, should not presumptuously accept favor and disorder the court's laws."
translations.idiomatic: Cong thereupon memorialized, "Your Majesty is just now entrusting the realm to utmost fairness; your servant, being of the empress's clan, should not presumptuously accept favor and disorder the court's laws."

sentences.zh: 族人敢因緣請托，願致於理。

translations.literal: "If clansmen dare use connections to seek favors, I ask that they be brought to justice."
translations.idiomatic: "If clansmen dare use connections to seek favors, I ask that they be brought to justice."

sentences.zh: 」時論稱之。

translations.literal: Contemporary opinion praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Contemporary opinion praised him.

sentences.zh: 出為環慶路馬步軍總管、知邠州，遷秦州防禦使、秦鳳路副都總管兼知秦州。

translations.literal: He was sent out as Overall Commander of cavalry and infantry of the Huanqing circuit and governor of Binzhou, transferred to Defense Commissioner of Qinzhou, Deputy Overall Commander of the Qinfeng circuit, and concurrently governor of Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out as Overall Commander of cavalry and infantry of the Huanqing circuit and governor of Binzhou, transferred to Defense Commissioner of Qinzhou, Deputy Overall Commander of the Qinfeng circuit, and concurrently governor of Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 度羨材為倉廩，大積谷古渭、冀城。

translations.literal: He estimated surplus timber for granaries and greatly stockpiled grain at Guwei and Jicheng.
translations.idiomatic: He estimated surplus timber for granaries and greatly stockpiled grain at Guwei and Jicheng.

sentences.zh: 生羌屢入鈔邊，琮懷以恩信，擊牛釃酒犒之，多請內屬。

translations.literal: Raw Qiang repeatedly entered to raid the border; Cong treated them with kindness and trust, slaughtered cattle and poured wine to reward them, and many requested to submit inward.
translations.idiomatic: Raw Qiang repeatedly entered to raid the border; Cong treated them with kindness and trust, slaughtered cattle and poured wine to reward them, and many requested to submit inward.

sentences.zh: 寶元初南郊，召入侍祠。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Baoyuan, when the southern suburban sacrifice was performed, he was summoned to attend the rites.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Baoyuan, when the southern suburban sacrifice was performed, he was summoned to attend the rites.

sentences.zh: 會元昊反，拜同州觀察使，復知秦州，上攻、守、禦三策。

translations.literal: When Yuanhao rebelled he was appointed Observation Commissioner of Tongzhou, again made governor of Qinzhou, and submitted three plans for attack, defense, and resistance.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuanhao rebelled he was appointed Observation Commissioner of Tongzhou, again made governor of Qinzhou, and submitted three plans for attack, defense, and resistance.

sentences.zh: 久之，兼同管勾涇原路兵馬、定國軍節度觀察留後。

translations.literal: After some time he was also made concurrent manager of Jingyuan circuit forces and Military Governor and Observation Regent of the Dingguo Army.
translations.idiomatic: After some time he was also made concurrent manager of Jingyuan circuit forces and Military Governor and Observation Regent of the Dingguo Army.

sentences.zh: 劉平、石元孫敗，關輔震恐。

translations.literal: When Liu Ping and Shi Yuansun were defeated, the Guanfu region was shaken with fear.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Ping and Shi Yuansun were defeated, the Guanfu region was shaken with fear.

sentences.zh: 琮請籍民為義軍，以張兵勢，於是料簡鄉弓手數萬人。

translations.literal: Cong requested registering the people as volunteer armies to display military strength, and thus selected tens of thousands of local archers.
translations.idiomatic: Cong requested registering the people as volunteer armies to display military strength, and thus selected tens of thousands of local archers.

sentences.zh: 賊寇山外，還天都，劫儀、秦屬戶。

translations.literal: Bandits raided beyond the mountains, returned to Tiandu, and plundered dependent households of Yi and Qin.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits raided beyond the mountains, returned to Tiandu, and plundered dependent households of Yi and Qin.

sentences.zh: 琮發騎士，設伏以待之，賊遂引去。

translations.literal: Cong sent out cavalry and set an ambush to await them; the bandits then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Cong sent out cavalry and set an ambush to await them; the bandits then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 琮欲誘吐蕃犄角圖賊，得西川舊賈，使諭意。

translations.literal: Cong wished to induce the Tibetans to join in a pincer against the bandits; he found an old merchant from Xichuan and had him convey his intent.
translations.idiomatic: Cong wished to induce the Tibetans to join in a pincer against the bandits; he found an old merchant from Xichuan and had him convey his intent.

sentences.zh: 而沙州鎮王子遣使奉書曰：「我本唐甥，天子實吾舅也。

translations.literal: The prince of Shazhou sent an envoy with a letter saying: "I am by origin a nephew of Tang; the Son of Heaven is truly my maternal uncle."
translations.idiomatic: The prince of Shazhou sent an envoy with a letter saying, "I am by origin a nephew of Tang; the Son of Heaven is truly my maternal uncle."

sentences.zh: 自党項破甘、涼，遂與漢隔。

translations.literal: "Since the Tangut broke Gan and Liang, we have been cut off from Han."
translations.idiomatic: "Since the Tangut broke Gan and Liang, we have been cut off from Han."

sentences.zh: 今願率首領為朝廷擊賊。

translations.literal: "Now I wish to lead the chiefs to strike the bandits for the court."
translations.idiomatic: "Now I wish to lead the chiefs to strike the bandits for the court."

sentences.zh: 」帝善琮策，改陝西副都總管、經略安撫招討副使，拜步軍副都指揮使。

translations.literal: The emperor approved Cong's plan, changed him to Deputy Overall Commander of Shaanxi, Deputy Commissioner for Pacification, Reassurance, and Suppression, and appointed him Deputy Commander of the Foot Guard.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved Cong's plan, changed him to Deputy Overall Commander of Shaanxi, Deputy Commissioner for Pacification, Reassurance, and Suppression, and appointed him Deputy Commander of the Foot Guard.

sentences.zh: 與夏竦屯鄜州，還為馬軍副都指揮使，以疾卒。

translations.literal: He encamped at Fuzhou with Xia Song, returned as Deputy Commander of the Cavalry Guard, and died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: He encamped at Fuzhou with Xia Song, returned as Deputy Commander of the Cavalry Guard, and died of illness.

sentences.zh: 帝臨奠，后並出臨喪，就第成服。

translations.literal: The emperor came in person to offer sacrifice; the empress also came out to mourn, and mourning garments were completed at his residence.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor came in person to offer sacrifice; the empress also came out to mourn, and mourning garments were completed at his residence.

sentences.zh: 贈安化軍節度使兼侍中，諡忠恪。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Military Governor of the Anhua Army and Concurrent Palace Attendant, with the posthumous title Zhongke.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Military Governor of the Anhua Army and Concurrent Palace Attendant, with the posthumous title Zhongke.

sentences.zh: 琮小心謹畏，善贊謁，御軍整嚴，死時家無餘貲。

translations.literal: Cong was cautious and reverent, skilled at attending audiences, commanded the army with strict discipline, and at death his household had no surplus wealth.
translations.idiomatic: Cong was cautious and reverent, skilled at attending audiences, commanded the army with strict discipline, and at death his household had no surplus wealth.

sentences.zh: 子牷，皇城使、嘉州防禦使。

translations.literal: His son Quan was Commissioner of the Imperial City and Defense Commissioner of Jiazhou.
translations.idiomatic: His son Quan was Commissioner of the Imperial City and Defense Commissioner of Jiazhou.

sentences.zh: 牷子詩，尚魯國大長公主。

translations.literal: Quan's son Shi married the Grand Eldest Princess of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: Quan's son Shi married the Grand Eldest Princess of Lu.

sentences.zh: 潘美，字仲詢，大名人。

translations.literal: Pan Mei, styled Zhongxun, was a native of Daming.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Mei, styled Zhongxun, was a native of Daming.

sentences.zh: 父璘，以軍校戍常山。

translations.literal: His father Lin served as a military officer garrisoning Changshan.
translations.idiomatic: His father Lin served as a military officer garrisoning Changshan.

sentences.zh: 美少倜儻，隸府中典謁。

translations.literal: Mei in youth was bold and free-spirited and served in the prefectural office as master of audiences.
translations.idiomatic: Mei in youth was bold and free-spirited and served in the prefectural office as master of audiences.

sentences.zh: 嘗語其里人王密曰：「漢代將終，凶臣肆虐，四海有改卜之兆。

translations.literal: He once said to his fellow townsman Wang Mi: "The Han dynasty is nearing its end; vicious ministers run rampant, and throughout the realm there are signs of a change of mandate."
translations.idiomatic: He once said to his fellow townsman Wang Mi, "The Han dynasty is nearing its end; vicious ministers run rampant, and throughout the realm there are signs of a change of mandate."

sentences.zh: 大丈夫不以此時立功名、取富貴，碌碌與萬物共盡，可羞也。

translations.literal: "A great man who does not at such a time establish merit and fame and seize wealth and honor, but perishes obscurely with all things — that is shameful."
translations.idiomatic: "A great man who does not at such a time establish merit and fame and seize wealth and honor, but perishes obscurely with all things — that is shameful."

sentences.zh: 」會周世宗為開封府尹，美以中涓事世宗。

translations.literal: When Shizong of Zhou was Prefect of Kaifeng, Mei served him as a palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizong of Zhou was Prefect of Kaifeng, Mei served him as a palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 及即位，補供奉官。

translations.literal: When he acceded to the throne, Mei was appointed a palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: When he acceded to the throne, Mei was appointed a palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 高平之戰，美以功遷西上閣門副使。

translations.literal: At the battle of Gaoping, Mei was promoted for merit to Deputy Upper West Gate Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: At the battle of Gaoping, Mei was promoted for merit to Deputy Upper West Gate Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 出監陝州軍，改引進使。

translations.literal: He was sent out to supervise the Shaanzhou army and was changed to Commissioner for Introducing Envoys.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out to supervise the Shaanzhou army and was changed to Commissioner for Introducing Envoys.

sentences.zh: 世宗將用師隴、蜀，命護永興屯兵，經度西事。

translations.literal: When Shizong was about to use troops in Long and Shu, he ordered Mei to oversee the Yongxing garrison and manage western affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizong was about to use troops in Long and Shu, he ordered Mei to oversee the Yongxing garrison and manage western affairs.

sentences.zh: 先是，太祖遇美素厚，及受禪，命美先往見執政，諭旨中外。

translations.literal: Earlier Taizu had long treated Mei with great favor; when he received the abdication he ordered Mei to go first to see the chief ministers and convey the imperial intent within and without.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Taizu had long treated Mei with great favor; when he received the abdication he ordered Mei to go first to see the chief ministers and convey the imperial intent within and without.

sentences.zh: 陝帥袁彥兇悍，信任群小，嗜殺黷貨，且繕甲兵，太祖慮其為變，遣美監其軍以圖之。

translations.literal: The Shaan commander Yuan Yan was fierce and brutal, trusted petty men, loved killing and coveted goods, and moreover repaired armor and weapons; Taizu feared he would rebel and sent Mei to supervise his army and deal with him.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaan commander Yuan Yan was fierce and brutal, trusted petty men, loved killing and coveted goods, and moreover repaired armor and weapons; Taizu feared he would rebel and sent Mei to supervise his army and deal with him.

sentences.zh: 美單騎往諭，以天命既歸，宜修臣職，彥遂入朝。

translations.literal: Mei went alone on horseback to instruct him that since Heaven's mandate had already shifted he should observe his duties as a subject; Yan then entered court.
translations.idiomatic: Mei went alone on horseback to instruct him that since Heaven's mandate had already shifted he should observe his duties as a subject; Yan then entered court.

sentences.zh: 上喜曰：「潘美不殺袁彥，能令來覲，成我志矣。」

translations.literal: The emperor rejoiced and said: "Pan Mei did not kill Yuan Yan but was able to make him come to audience — he has fulfilled my wish."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rejoiced and said, "Pan Mei did not kill Yuan Yan but was able to make him come to audience — he has fulfilled my wish."

sentences.zh: 李重進叛，太祖親征，命石守信為招討使，美為行營都監以副之。

translations.literal: When Li Chongjin rebelled Taizu personally campaigned; Shi Shouxin was appointed Suppression Commissioner and Mei Overall Supervisory Commissioner of the field camp as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Chongjin rebelled Taizu personally campaigned; Shi Shouxin was appointed Suppression Commissioner and Mei Overall Supervisory Commissioner of the field camp as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 揚州平，留為巡檢，以任鎮撫，以功授秦州團練使。

translations.literal: When Yangzhou was pacified he was left as inspector to take charge of pacification; for merit he was made regimental commissioner of Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Yangzhou was pacified he was left as inspector to take charge of pacification; for merit he was made regimental commissioner of Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 時湖南叛將汪端既平，人心未寧，乃授美潭州防禦使。

translations.literal: When the Hunan rebel general Wang Duan had just been pacified and the people's hearts were not yet settled, Mei was made Defense Commissioner of Tanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When the Hunan rebel general Wang Duan had just been pacified and the people's hearts were not yet settled, Mei was made Defense Commissioner of Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 嶺南劉鋹數寇桂陽、江華，美擊走之。

translations.literal: Liu Chang of Lingnan repeatedly raided Guiyang and Jianghua; Mei attacked and drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Chang of Lingnan repeatedly raided Guiyang and Jianghua; Mei attacked and drove him off.

sentences.zh: 溪峒蠻獠自唐以來，不時侵略，頗為民患。

translations.literal: Since Tang times the barbarians and liao of the stream gorges had from time to time invaded and were a considerable affliction to the people.
translations.idiomatic: Since Tang times the barbarians and liao of the stream gorges had from time to time invaded and were a considerable affliction to the people.

sentences.zh: 美窮其巢穴，多所殺獲，餘加慰撫，夷落遂定。

translations.literal: Mei tracked down their lairs, killed and captured many, and soothed the remainder; the barbarian settlements were then settled.
translations.idiomatic: Mei tracked down their lairs, killed and captured many, and soothed the remainder; the barbarian settlements were then settled.

sentences.zh: 乾德二年，又從兵馬都監丁德裕等率兵克郴州。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qiande he again followed the military commissioner Ding Deyu and others in leading troops to take Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qiande he again followed the military commissioner Ding Deyu and others in leading troops to take Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 開寶三年，征嶺南，以美為行營諸軍都部署、朗州團練使，尹崇珂副之。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kaibao, when Lingnan was campaigned against, Mei was made Overall Commander of all armies of the field camp and regimental commissioner of Langzhou, with Yin Chongke as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Kaibao, when Lingnan was campaigned against, Mei was made Overall Commander of all armies of the field camp and regimental commissioner of Langzhou, with Yin Chongke as deputy.

sentences.zh: 進克富川，鋹遣將率眾萬餘來援，遇戰大破之，遂克賀州。

translations.literal: Advancing he took Fuchuan; Chang sent a general with more than ten thousand to reinforce; they met in battle and were crushingly defeated, and Hezhou was then taken.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing he took Fuchuan; Chang sent a general with more than ten thousand to reinforce; they met in battle and were crushingly defeated, and Hezhou was then taken.

sentences.zh: 十月，又下昭、桂、連三州，西江諸州以次降。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he also took Zhao, Gui, and Lian prefectures, and the prefectures of the West River submitted in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he also took Zhao, Gui, and Lian prefectures, and the prefectures of the West River submitted in succession.

sentences.zh: 美以功移南面都部署，進次韶州。

translations.literal: For merit Mei was transferred to Overall Commander of the Southern Front and advanced to halt at Shaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: For merit Mei was transferred to Overall Commander of the Southern Front and advanced to halt at Shaozhou.

sentences.zh: 韶，廣之北門也，賊眾十餘萬聚焉。

translations.literal: Shao was the northern gate of Guang; more than a hundred thousand enemy troops gathered there.
translations.idiomatic: Shao was the northern gate of Guang; more than a hundred thousand enemy troops gathered there.

sentences.zh: 美揮兵進乘之，韶州遂拔，斬獲數萬計。

translations.literal: Mei waved his troops forward to press the advantage; Shaozhou was then taken, with tens of thousands beheaded or captured.
translations.idiomatic: Mei waved his troops forward to press the advantage; Shaozhou was then taken, with tens of thousands beheaded or captured.

sentences.zh: 鋹窮蹙，四年二月，遣其臣王珪詣軍門求通好，又遣其左僕射蕭漼、中書舍人卓惟休奉表乞降。

translations.literal: Chang, hard pressed, in the second month of the fourth year sent his minister Wang Gui to the camp gate to seek friendly relations, and also sent his Left Vice Director Xiao Huan and Drafting Attendant Zhuo Weixiu with a memorial begging to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Chang, hard pressed, in the second month of the fourth year sent his minister Wang Gui to the camp gate to seek friendly relations, and also sent his Left Vice Director Xiao Huan and Drafting Attendant Zhuo Weixiu with a memorial begging to surrender.

sentences.zh: 美因諭以上意，以為彼能戰則與之戰，不能戰則勸之守，不能守則諭之降，不能降則死，不能死則亡，非此五者，他不得受。

translations.literal: Mei thereupon conveyed the emperor's intent: if they could fight then fight them; if they could not fight then urge them to hold; if they could not hold then instruct them to surrender; if they could not surrender then die; if they could not die then perish — apart from these five, nothing else would be accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Mei thereupon conveyed the emperor's intent: if they could fight then fight them; if they could not fight then urge them to hold; if they could not hold then instruct them to surrender; if they could not surrender then die; if they could not die then perish — apart from these five, nothing else would be accepted.

sentences.zh: 美既令殿直冉彥袞部送漼等赴闕。

translations.literal: Mei then ordered the Palace Attendant Ran Yangun to escort Huan and the others to court.
translations.idiomatic: Mei then ordered the Palace Attendant Ran Yangun to escort Huan and the others to court.

sentences.zh: 鋹復遣其弟保興率眾拒戰，美即率厲士卒倍道趨柵頭，距廣州百二十里。

translations.literal: Chang again sent his younger brother Bao Xing to lead troops in resistance; Mei at once roused his soldiers and marched by forced stages to Zhantou, one hundred twenty li from Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Chang again sent his younger brother Bao Xing to lead troops in resistance; Mei at once roused his soldiers and marched by forced stages to Zhantou, one hundred twenty li from Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 鋹兵十五萬依山谷堅壁以待，美因築壘休士，與諸將計曰：「彼編竹木為柵，若攻之以火，彼必潰亂。

translations.literal: Chang's army of a hundred fifty thousand relied on the mountain valleys and held fast in walled camps to await them; Mei therefore built camps and rested the soldiers, and said to the generals: "They have woven bamboo and wood into palisades — if we attack with fire they will surely break into disorder."
translations.idiomatic: Chang's army of a hundred fifty thousand relied on the mountain valleys and held fast in walled camps to await them; Mei therefore built camps and rested the soldiers, and said to the generals, "They have woven bamboo and wood into palisades — if we attack with fire they will surely break into disorder."

sentences.zh: 因以銳師夾擊之，萬全策也。

translations.literal: "Then with elite troops strike them from both sides — that is the plan of complete success."
translations.idiomatic: "Then with elite troops strike them from both sides — that is the plan of complete success."

sentences.zh: 」遂分遣丁夫數千人，人持二炬，間道造其柵。

translations.literal: He then dispatched several thousand laborers, each holding two torches, by hidden paths to reach their palisades.
translations.idiomatic: He then dispatched several thousand laborers, each holding two torches, by hidden paths to reach their palisades.

sentences.zh: 及夜，萬炬俱發，會天大風，火勢甚熾。

translations.literal: At night ten thousand torches were lit together; a great wind arose and the fire blazed fiercely.
translations.idiomatic: At night ten thousand torches were lit together; a great wind arose and the fire blazed fiercely.

sentences.zh: 鋹眾驚擾來犯，美揮兵急擊之，鋹眾大敗，斬數萬計。

translations.literal: Chang's troops, alarmed and thrown into disorder, came to attack; Mei waved his troops in a swift strike and Chang's army was heavily defeated, with tens of thousands beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Chang's troops, alarmed and thrown into disorder, came to attack; Mei waved his troops in a swift strike and Chang's army was heavily defeated, with tens of thousands beheaded.

sentences.zh: 長驅至廣州，鋹盡焚其府庫，遂克之，擒鋹送京師，露布以聞。

translations.literal: He drove straight to Guangzhou; Chang burned all his treasuries, and the city was then taken; Chang was captured and sent to the capital, and a victory bulletin was submitted.
translations.idiomatic: He drove straight to Guangzhou; Chang burned all his treasuries, and the city was then taken; Chang was captured and sent to the capital, and a victory bulletin was submitted.

sentences.zh: 即日，命美與尹崇珂同知廣州兼市舶使。

translations.literal: That same day Mei and Yin Chongke were jointly made governors of Guangzhou and concurrently commissioners of maritime trade.
translations.idiomatic: That same day Mei and Yin Chongke were jointly made governors of Guangzhou and concurrently commissioners of maritime trade.

sentences.zh: 五月，拜山南東道節度。

translations.literal: In the fifth month he was appointed military governor of the Shannan East circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he was appointed military governor of the Shannan East circuit.

sentences.zh: 五年，兼嶺南道轉運使。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was also made Transport Commissioner of the Lingnan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was also made Transport Commissioner of the Lingnan circuit.

sentences.zh: 土豪周思瓊聚眾負海為亂，美討平之，嶺表遂安。

translations.literal: The local strongman Zhou Siqiong gathered a crowd and relied on the sea to rebel; Mei suppressed and pacified him, and the Lingnan region was then secure.
translations.idiomatic: The local strongman Zhou Siqiong gathered a crowd and relied on the sea to rebel; Mei suppressed and pacified him, and the Lingnan region was then secure.

sentences.zh: 八年，議征江南。

translations.literal: In the eighth year a campaign against Jiangnan was discussed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year a campaign against Jiangnan was discussed.

sentences.zh: 九月，遣美與劉遇等率兵先赴江陵。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Mei was sent with Liu Yu and others to lead troops first to Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Mei was sent with Liu Yu and others to lead troops first to Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 十月，命美為升州道行營都監，與曹彬偕往，進次秦淮。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Mei was ordered Overall Supervisory Commissioner of the Shengzhou route field camp and went together with Cao Bin, advancing to halt at the Qinhuai.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Mei was ordered Overall Supervisory Commissioner of the Shengzhou route field camp and went together with Cao Bin, advancing to halt at the Qinhuai.

sentences.zh: 時舟楫未具，美下令曰：「美受詔，提驍果數萬人，期於必勝，豈限此一衣帶水而不徑度乎？

translations.literal: When boats and oars were not yet ready Mei issued an order: "Mei has received the edict and leads tens of thousands of elite troops, expecting certain victory — how can we be stopped by this belt of water and not cross directly?"
translations.idiomatic: When boats and oars were not yet ready Mei issued an order, "Mei has received the edict and leads tens of thousands of elite troops, expecting certain victory — how can we be stopped by this belt of water and not cross directly?"

sentences.zh: 」遂麾以涉，大軍隨之，吳師大敗。

translations.literal: He then waved them across; the great army followed, and the Wu forces were heavily defeated.
translations.idiomatic: He then waved them across; the great army followed, and the Wu forces were heavily defeated.

sentences.zh: 及採石磯浮梁成，吳人以戰艦二十餘鳴鼓溯流來趨利。

translations.literal: When the floating bridge at Caishiji was finished, the Wu sent more than twenty warships beating drums upstream to seize advantage.
translations.idiomatic: When the floating bridge at Caishiji was finished, the Wu sent more than twenty warships beating drums upstream to seize advantage.

sentences.zh: 美麾兵奮擊，奪其戰艦，擒其將鄭賓等七人，又破其城南水砦，分舟師守之。

translations.literal: Mei waved his troops in a fierce attack, seized their warships, captured seven of their generals including Zheng Bin, also broke their southern water fort, and divided the fleet to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: Mei waved his troops in a fierce attack, seized their warships, captured seven of their generals including Zheng Bin, also broke their southern water fort, and divided the fleet to garrison it.

sentences.zh: 奏至，太祖遣使令亟徙置戰棹，以防他變。

translations.literal: When the memorial arrived Taizu sent envoys ordering the warships to be moved at once to guard against other changes.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial arrived Taizu sent envoys ordering the warships to be moved at once to guard against other changes.

sentences.zh: 美聞詔即徙軍。

translations.literal: Mei, hearing the edict, moved the army at once.
translations.idiomatic: Mei, hearing the edict, moved the army at once.

sentences.zh: 是夜，吳人果來攻砦，不能克。

translations.literal: That night the Wu indeed came to attack the fort and could not take it.
translations.idiomatic: That night the Wu indeed came to attack the fort and could not take it.

sentences.zh: 進薄金陵，江南水陸十萬陳於城下，美率兵襲擊，大敗之。

translations.literal: Advancing close to Jinling, a hundred thousand Jiangnan land and river forces were drawn up below the city; Mei led troops in a surprise attack and heavily defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing close to Jinling, a hundred thousand Jiangnan land and river forces were drawn up below the city; Mei led troops in a surprise attack and heavily defeated them.

sentences.zh: 李煜危甚，遣徐鉉來乞緩師，上不之省，仍詔諸將促令歸附。

translations.literal: Li Yu was in extreme peril and sent Xu Xuan to beg a respite for the army; the emperor paid no heed and still edicted the generals to urge submission.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yu was in extreme peril and sent Xu Xuan to beg a respite for the army; the emperor paid no heed and still edicted the generals to urge submission.

sentences.zh: 煜遷延未能決，夜遣兵數千，持炬鼓噪來犯我師。

translations.literal: Li Yu delayed and could not decide; by night he sent several thousand troops with torches, beating drums and shouting, to attack our army.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yu delayed and could not decide; by night he sent several thousand troops with torches, beating drums and shouting, to attack our army.

sentences.zh: 美率精銳以短兵接戰，因與大將曹彬率士晨夜攻城，百道俱進。

translations.literal: Mei led elite troops into close combat; then together with the great general Cao Bin he led soldiers day and night to assault the city from a hundred directions at once.
translations.idiomatic: Mei led elite troops into close combat; then together with the great general Cao Bin he led soldiers day and night to assault the city from a hundred directions at once.

sentences.zh: 金陵平，以功拜宣徽北院使。

translations.literal: When Jinling was pacified he was appointed Commissioner of the Northern Court of the Palace Secretariat for merit.
translations.idiomatic: When Jinling was pacified he was appointed Commissioner of the Northern Court of the Palace Secretariat for merit.

sentences.zh: 秋，命副黨進攻太原，戰於汾上，破之，且多擒獲。

translations.literal: In autumn he was ordered to assist Dang Jin in attacking Taiyuan; they fought on the Fen River, defeated the enemy, and captured many.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn he was ordered to assist Dang Jin in attacking Taiyuan; they fought on the Fen River, defeated the enemy, and captured many.

sentences.zh: 太平興國初，改南院使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Taiping Xingguo he was changed to Commissioner of the Southern Court.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Taiping Xingguo he was changed to Commissioner of the Southern Court.

sentences.zh: 三年，加開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In the third year he was given the honor of Grand Preceptor with the ceremonial trappings of a separate office.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was given the honor of Grand Preceptor with the ceremonial trappings of a separate office.

sentences.zh: 四年，命將征太原，美為北路都招討，判太原行府事。

translations.literal: In the fourth year generals were ordered to campaign against Taiyuan; Mei was Overall Suppression Commissioner of the northern route and administrator of the Taiyuan field headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year generals were ordered to campaign against Taiyuan; Mei was Overall Suppression Commissioner of the northern route and administrator of the Taiyuan field headquarters.

sentences.zh: 部分諸將進討，并州遂平。

translations.literal: He assigned the generals to advance and suppress, and Bingzhou was then pacified.
translations.idiomatic: He assigned the generals to advance and suppress, and Bingzhou was then pacified.

sentences.zh: 繼征范陽，以美知幽州行府事。

translations.literal: Continuing the campaign against Fanyang, Mei was made administrator of the Youzhou field headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Continuing the campaign against Fanyang, Mei was made administrator of the Youzhou field headquarters.

sentences.zh: 及班師，命兼三交都部署，留屯以捍北邊。

translations.literal: When the army withdrew he was ordered concurrently Overall Commander of Sanjiao and left encamped to defend the northern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: When the army withdrew he was ordered concurrently Overall Commander of Sanjiao and left encamped to defend the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 三交西北三百里，地名固軍，其地險阻，為北邊咽喉。

translations.literal: Three hundred li northwest of Sanjiao was a place called Gujun; the terrain was perilous and it was the throat of the northern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Three hundred li northwest of Sanjiao was a place called Gujun; the terrain was perilous and it was the throat of the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 美潛師襲之，遂據有其地。

translations.literal: Mei sent troops in secret to strike it and then held the place.
translations.idiomatic: Mei sent troops in secret to strike it and then held the place.

sentences.zh: 因積粟屯兵以守之，自是北邊以寧。

translations.literal: He then stockpiled grain and garrisoned troops to hold it; from then on the northern frontier was secure.
translations.idiomatic: He then stockpiled grain and garrisoned troops to hold it; from then on the northern frontier was secure.

sentences.zh: 美嘗巡撫至代州，既秣馬蓐食，俄而遼兵萬騎來寇，近塞，美誓眾銜枚奮擊，大破之。

translations.literal: Mei once on inspection reached Daizhou; after feeding the horses and taking a meal in the saddle, suddenly ten thousand Khitan cavalry came to raid near the frontier; Mei swore the troops to battle, had them bite the gag-sticks, and struck fiercely, heavily defeating them.
translations.idiomatic: Mei once on inspection reached Daizhou; after feeding the horses and taking a meal in the saddle, suddenly ten thousand Khitan cavalry came to raid near the frontier; Mei swore the troops to battle, had them bite the gag-sticks, and struck fiercely, heavily defeating them.

sentences.zh: 封代國公。

translations.literal: He was enfeoffed as Duke of Dai.
translations.idiomatic: He was enfeoffed as Duke of Dai.

sentences.zh: 八年，改忠武軍節度，進封韓國公。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was changed to military governor of the Zhongwu Army and advanced to Duke of Han.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was changed to military governor of the Zhongwu Army and advanced to Duke of Han.

sentences.zh: 雍熙三年，詔美及曹彬、崔彥進等北伐，美獨拔寰、朔、雲、應等州。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongxi an edict ordered Mei with Cao Bin, Cui Yanjin, and others to march north; Mei alone took Huan, Shuo, Yun, Ying, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yongxi an edict ordered Mei with Cao Bin, Cui Yanjin, and others to march north; Mei alone took Huan, Shuo, Yun, Ying, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 詔內徙其民。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the people moved inward.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the people moved inward.

sentences.zh: 會遼兵奄至，戰于陳家谷口，不利，驍將楊業死之。

translations.literal: When Khitan troops suddenly arrived they fought at Chenjiagu Pass without success; the fierce general Yang Ye died there.
translations.idiomatic: When Khitan troops suddenly arrived they fought at Chenjiagu Pass without success; the fierce general Yang Ye died there.

sentences.zh: 美坐削秩三等，責授檢校太保。

translations.literal: Mei was punished by reduction of three ranks and was demoted to Honorary Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Mei was punished by reduction of three ranks and was demoted to Honorary Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 明年，復檢校太師。

translations.literal: The next year he was restored to Honorary Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was restored to Honorary Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 知真定府，未幾，改都部署、判并州。

translations.literal: He was made governor of Zhending Prefecture; before long he was changed to Overall Commander and administrator of Bingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was made governor of Zhending Prefecture; before long he was changed to Overall Commander and administrator of Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 加同平章事，數月卒，年六十七。

translations.literal: He was given the title Concurrent Grand Counselor; after several months he died, aged sixty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: He was given the title Concurrent Grand Counselor; after several months he died, aged sixty-seven.

sentences.zh: 贈中書令，諡武惠。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Director of the Secretariat with the posthumous title Wuhui.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Director of the Secretariat with the posthumous title Wuhui.

sentences.zh: 咸平二年，配饗太宗廟庭。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianping he was granted shared sacrificial honors in the court of Taizong's temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianping he was granted shared sacrificial honors in the court of Taizong's temple.

sentences.zh: 子惟德至宮苑使，惟固西上閣門使，惟正西京作坊使，惟清崇儀使，惟熙娶秦王女，平州刺史。

translations.literal: His sons Weide rose to Commissioner of the Palace Parks; Weigu to Upper West Gate Commissioner; Weizheng to Commissioner of the Western Capital Workshops; Weiqing to Commissioner of Honored Ceremonial; Weixi married the Prince of Qin's daughter and was Prefect of Pingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: His sons Weide rose to Commissioner of the Palace Parks; Weigu to Upper West Gate Commissioner; Weizheng to Commissioner of the Western Capital Workshops; Weiqing to Commissioner of Honored Ceremonial; Weixi married the Prince of Qin's daughter and was Prefect of Pingzhou.

sentences.zh: 惟熙女，即章懷皇后也。

translations.literal: Weixi's daughter was none other than Empress Zhanghuai.
translations.idiomatic: Weixi's daughter was none other than Empress Zhanghuai.

sentences.zh: 美後追封鄭王，以章懷故也。

translations.literal: Mei was later posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Zheng because of Zhanghuai.
translations.idiomatic: Mei was later posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Zheng because of Zhanghuai.

sentences.zh: 惟吉，美從子，累資為天雄軍駐泊都監。

translations.literal: Weiji was Mei's nephew by the male line; by accumulated seniority he became Overall Garrison Commissioner of the Tianxiong Army.
translations.idiomatic: Weiji was Mei's nephew by the male line; by accumulated seniority he became Overall Garrison Commissioner of the Tianxiong Army.

sentences.zh: 雖連戚里，能以禮法自飭，揚曆中外，人咸稱其勤敏云。

translations.literal: Though connected to the imperial affines, he was able to restrain himself by ritual and law; serving at court and in the provinces, all praised his diligence and quickness.
translations.idiomatic: Though connected to the imperial affines, he was able to restrain himself by ritual and law; serving at court and in the provinces, all praised his diligence and quickness.

sentences.zh: 李超 附

translations.literal: Li Chao — appended
translations.idiomatic: Li Chao — appended

sentences.zh: 李超者，冀州信都人。

translations.literal: Li Chao was a man of Xindu in Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Chao was a native of Xindu in Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 為禁卒，常從潘美軍中，主刑刀。

translations.literal: He was a palace guard soldier and often followed Pan Mei's army, in charge of the executioner's blade.
translations.idiomatic: He was a palace guard soldier and often followed Pan Mei's army, in charge of the executioner's blade.

sentences.zh: 美好乘怒殺人，超每潛緩之。

translations.literal: When Mei in anger wished to kill someone, Chao always secretly slowed the matter.
translations.idiomatic: When Mei in anger wished to kill someone, Chao always secretly slowed the matter.

sentences.zh: 美怒解，輒得釋，以是全者甚眾，人謂其有陰德。

translations.literal: When Mei's anger subsided they were always released; thus very many were preserved, and people said he had hidden virtue.
translations.idiomatic: When Mei's anger subsided they were always released; thus very many were preserved, and people said he had hidden virtue.

sentences.zh: 子浚，字德淵。

translations.literal: His son Jun, styled Deyuan.
translations.idiomatic: His son Jun, styled Deyuan.

sentences.zh: 中進士，累擢秘書、知康州。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination and was repeatedly promoted to Secretary and governor of Kangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination and was repeatedly promoted to Secretary and governor of Kangzhou.

sentences.zh: 咸平中，入為刑部詳覆、御史臺推直官。

translations.literal: During Xianping he entered court as Reviewer of the Ministry of Justice and Direct Investigator of the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: During Xianping he entered court as Reviewer of the Ministry of Justice and Direct Investigator of the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 屢上書言事，遷開封府推官，賜緋魚。

translations.literal: He repeatedly submitted memorials on affairs of state, was transferred to Investigating Official of Kaifeng Prefecture, and was granted the crimson fish pouch.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly submitted memorials on affairs of state, was transferred to Investigating Official of Kaifeng Prefecture, and was granted the crimson fish pouch.

sentences.zh: 景德初，拜虞部員外郎兼侍御史知雜事，賜金紫。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jingde he was appointed Outer Gentleman of the Ministry of Works and concurrently Censor-in-Charge of Miscellaneous Affairs, and was granted gold and purple.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jingde he was appointed Outer Gentleman of the Ministry of Works and concurrently Censor-in-Charge of Miscellaneous Affairs, and was granted gold and purple.

sentences.zh: 從幸澶淵，頗上疏言便宜。

translations.literal: He followed the emperor to Chanzhou and frequently submitted memorials on expedient measures.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the emperor to Chanzhou and frequently submitted memorials on expedient measures.

sentences.zh: 師還，命與陳堯咨安撫河北。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was ordered with Chen Yaozi to pacify Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned he was ordered with Chen Yaozi to pacify Hebei.

sentences.zh: 逾年，判吏部銓。

translations.literal: After more than a year he was made administrator of the Ministry of Personnel's selection board.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year he was made administrator of the Ministry of Personnel's selection board.

sentences.zh: 浚居憲府，未再歲，帝寵待之，擢樞密直學士。

translations.literal: Jun served in the Censorate; before two years had passed the emperor favored him and promoted him to Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Jun served in the Censorate; before two years had passed the emperor favored him and promoted him to Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 宰相王旦言：「浚雖有剸劇才，然驟曆清切，時望未允。

translations.literal: The chief minister Wang Dan said: "Though Jun has talent for cutting through difficult affairs, he has suddenly passed through exalted and intimate posts, and public expectation is not yet satisfied."
translations.idiomatic: The chief minister Wang Dan said, "Though Jun has talent for cutting through difficult affairs, he has suddenly passed through exalted and intimate posts, and public expectation is not yet satisfied."

sentences.zh: 」真宗曰：「朕業已許之矣。

translations.literal: Zhenzong said: "I have already promised it."
translations.idiomatic: Zhenzong said, "I have already promised it."

sentences.zh: 」尋知開封，能檢察隱微，京師稱之。

translations.literal: Soon he was made governor of Kaifeng; he was able to investigate hidden matters, and the capital praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was made governor of Kaifeng; he was able to investigate hidden matters, and the capital praised him.

sentences.zh: 累遷至右司郎中，出知秦州，暴疾卒。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Director of the Right Bureau; sent out to govern Qinzhou, he died suddenly of illness.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to Director of the Right Bureau; sent out to govern Qinzhou, he died suddenly of illness.

sentences.zh: 浚與李宗諤同歲同月後一日生，其卒也亦後一日，眾以為異。

translations.literal: Jun was born in the same year and month as Li Zong'e, one day later; he also died one day later, and the multitude considered it strange.
translations.idiomatic: Jun was born in the same year and month as Li Zong'e, one day later; he also died one day later, and the multitude considered it strange.

sentences.zh: 論曰：曹彬以器識受知太祖，遂膺柄用。

translations.literal: The commentary says: Cao Bin, by his capacity and insight, won Taizu's recognition and thus received appointment to power.
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: Cao Bin, by his capacity and insight, won Taizu's recognition and thus received appointment to power.

sentences.zh: 平居，於百蟲之蟄猶不忍傷，出使吳越，籍上私饋，悉用施予，而不留一錢；

translations.literal: In ordinary life he could not bear to harm even hibernating insects; on mission to Wuyue he recorded private gifts, distributed them all in charity, and kept not a single coin;
translations.idiomatic: In ordinary life he could not bear to harm even hibernating insects; on mission to Wuyue he recorded private gifts, distributed them all in charity, and kept not a single coin;

sentences.zh: 則其總戎專征，而秋毫無犯，不妄戮一人者，益可信矣。

translations.literal: then that in overall command of armies on independent campaigns he took not the slightest thing and did not kill anyone wantonly is all the more credible.
translations.idiomatic: then that in overall command of armies on independent campaigns he took not the slightest thing and did not kill anyone wantonly is all the more credible.

sentences.zh: 潘美素厚太祖，信任于得位之初，遂受征討之託。

translations.literal: Pan Mei had long been close to Taizu and was trusted at the beginning of his accession; he thus received the charge of campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Mei had long been close to Taizu and was trusted at the beginning of his accession; he thus received the charge of campaigns.

sentences.zh: 劉鋹遣使乞降，觀美所喻，辭義嚴正，得奉辭伐罪之體；

translations.literal: When Liu Chang sent envoys begging to surrender, observing what Mei instructed, the words were stern and upright and possessed the form of punishing crime on behalf of the mandate;
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Chang sent envoys begging to surrender, observing what Mei instructed, the words were stern and upright and possessed the form of punishing crime on behalf of the mandate;

sentences.zh: 則其威名之重，豈待平嶺表、定江南、征太原、鎮北門而後見哉？

translations.literal: then must his weight of martial renown wait until pacifying Lingnan, settling Jiangnan, campaigning against Taiyuan, and guarding the northern gate before it is seen?
translations.idiomatic: then must his weight of martial renown wait until pacifying Lingnan, settling Jiangnan, campaigning against Taiyuan, and guarding the northern gate before it is seen?

sentences.zh: 二人皆諡武惠，皆與配饗，兩家子孫，皆能樹立，享富貴。

translations.literal: Both were given the posthumous title Wuhui, both shared sacrificial honors, and the descendants of both houses were all able to establish themselves and enjoy wealth and honor.
translations.idiomatic: Both were given the posthumous title Wuhui, both shared sacrificial honors, and the descendants of both houses were all able to establish themselves and enjoy wealth and honor.

sentences.zh: 而光獻、章懷皆稱賢后，非偶然也。

translations.literal: Moreover Guangxian and Zhanghuai were both called virtuous empresses — this was no accident.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Guangxian and Zhanghuai were both called virtuous empresses — this was no accident.

sentences.zh: 君子謂仁恕清慎，能保功名，守法度，唯彬為宋良將第一，豈無意哉？

translations.literal: The noble-minded say that in benevolence, forbearance, purity, and prudence, in preserving merit and fame and observing law and measure, Bin alone was Song's foremost good general — was this without reason?
translations.idiomatic: The noble-minded say that in benevolence, forbearance, purity, and prudence, in preserving merit and fame and observing law and measure, Bin alone was Song's foremost good general — was this without reason?

sentences.zh: 若李浚者，亦以材幹自結主知，遂曆清顯。

translations.literal: As for Li Jun, he too by talent and capability won the ruler's favor and thus passed through exalted and prominent posts.
translations.idiomatic: As for Li Jun, he too by talent and capability won the ruler's favor and thus passed through exalted and prominent posts.

sentences.zh: 謂為陰德所致，理或然也。

translations.literal: To say this was caused by hidden virtue — the principle may well be so.
translations.idiomatic: To say this was caused by hidden virtue — the principle may well be so.
